claims.claim_text: Pandemic supply-chain disruptions increased prices for everyday items including food, gasoline and airfare.
President Biden pledges to continue criticizing companies for price gouging when they do not lower consumer prices in line with falling costs.
The 2024 Democratic platform credits the Biden administration with lowering gasoline prices for American families through record clean-energy, oil and gas production.
The 2024 Democratic platform states that the Biden administration released nearly 200 million barrels of gasoline from the Strategic Petroleum and Northeast Gasoline Supply reserves.

The Biden administration is lowering gasoline prices by up to an additional 25 cents per gallon in certain markets, particularly the Midwest, by making cheaper E15 ethanol-blended gasoline available each summer.
The Biden administration is taking action to prevent oil-company collusion that could further increase prices.
